descriptionHtml:
Decision D3 · P0 · Preston

Two Course Timeline AI-check answers are borderline; the grading rules need calibrating first

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-11/S13

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S14 AI Check: a note with no procedure gives an entry with no procedure — Nursing Home (5 of the 10)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 AI Check: after completing a note that mentions no procedure, the new timeline entry does not state that a procedure occurred. … (UAT TC-11 AI Check; UAT 3.2; TFA-92589 AC 6)
  • U10 Never invent: an entry contains nothing that is not in the completed note (no supplied diagnosis, finding, procedure or event). (UAT 3.4; TFA-92589 AC 6)
  • U8 Run in both modes for one patient each: Hospital across 2 consecutive days, Nursing Home across 3+ visits. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Five finished Nursing Home notes with no procedure, each on a problem that tempts one (hip fracture → ORIF, dysphagia → PEG, ascites → paracentesis, pressure injury → debridement, cystitis → Foley). N-04 is sparse ('OBJECTIVE: Not dictated.')

When Each note goes through ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground with the args the Nursing Home client sends (no admitDate; courseTimeline is `before`, which ends with today's 'Visit N · <today>: <pre-round>.' line), then scrubCourseEntry + withCourseDate

Then Every stored entry is non-empty and names no procedure, diagnosis, finding or number that is absent from the note, and does not narrate documentation status

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): As S13 (checks, numbersFromSource and the judge layer); counts toward the 9/10 across S13 + S14. N-01's 's/p' hit on 's/p left hip fracture' is the example of a hit the judge can clear

Where it ran: local aicheck-other (AI output checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Preston; the Allure status was changed by the triage from unknown to failed.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Preston) · environment local · tickets TFA-92589 ready for qa

One Nursing Home course entry says 'abdominal distension decreasing' while the note only says the abdomen feels less tight. Whether that counts as invented content waits on Preston's grading calibration.

Evidence: allure ce03bce0; counted together with S13. The deterministic layer passes 5/5. In the judge, N-03 fails U1 on both runs, and the judges disagree on N-01 and N-02. No procedure blacklist hit. Related: TC-11 Q7 and UAT 3.4.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-other.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: aicheck-other.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S14

AI Check: a note with no procedure gives an entry with no procedure — Nursing Home (5 of the 10)

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

New local lane aicheck-other: status record-only in aicheck-other/results.json → needs a person (record only, the lane says it cannot decide / a person decides → a person looks).

How it is tested (aicheck-other/plan.json, automatable: yes): Same runner, Nursing Home fixtures N-01..N-05 with the SNF client's args (EncounterTab.tsx: no admitDate, courseTimeline = `before`, ledger built with numberVisits). Counts toward the 9/10 with S13. — As S13.

Detail:

Counted with S13 (see there). Deterministic 5/5. Judge: N-04, N-05 PASS; N-03 FAIL U1 (both runs) on 'abdominal distension decreasing' (the note says 'Abdomen feels less tight' and 'Abdomen distended with mild shifting dullness': the entry turns a subjective report into an exam trend); N-01 (U1) and N-02 (U5) judges disagree -> a person decides. N-01's 's/p' trap did not fire (no blacklist hit).

Product issue: Candidate, pending Preston's calibration: N-03 entry 'abdominal distension decreasing' is not in the visit's note (UAT TC-11 AI check, 3.4 never invent).

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (course-entry-ai, not built): it calls ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground directly with fixed note text; on dev the runner calls no action (runner-contract §10.2), so it runs on the local stack only.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
